(* =================================================================================================

(* SUB-SECTION 2.1: CARRIER HEAVE ACCELEROMETER (Z-AXIS) 2oo3 TMR VOTING *)
(* Channel Pairwise Absolute Discrepancy Evaluation *)
IF ABS(rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 - rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2) > rAccelDevLimit_mps2 THEN
    IF ABS(rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 - rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) > rAccelDevLimit_mps2 THEN
        (* Channel A has diverged from both Channel B and Channel C *)
        bAccelChA_Healthy := FALSE;
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 + rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) * 0.50;
        dwWarningWord     := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000001; (* Warning: Accel ChA Degraded *)
    ELSE
        (* Channel B has diverged from Channel A and Channel C *)
        bAccelChB_Healthy := FALSE;
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 + rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) * 0.50;
        dwWarningWord     := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000002; (* Warning: Accel ChB Degraded *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF ABS(rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 - rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) > rAccelDevLimit_mps2 THEN
    (* Channel C has diverged from Channel A and Channel B *)
    bAccelChC_Healthy := FALSE;
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 + rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2) * 0.50;
    dwWarningWord     := dwWarningWord OR 16#00000004; (* Warning: Accel ChC Degraded *)
ELSE
    (* All three channels concordant: Pure Median Voting *)
    IF (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) OR
       (rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2;
    ELSIF (rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) OR
          (rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 <= rCarrierAccelZ_ChA_mps2 AND rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2 >= rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rCarrierAccelZ_ChB_mps2;

        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rCarrierAccelZ_ChC_mps2;

(* SUB-SECTION 2.2: CRYOSTAT SHIELD TEMPERATURE 2oo3 TMR VOTING *)

    IF (rCryoTempShield_ChA_K >= rCryoTempShield_ChB_K AND rCryoTempShield_ChA_K <= rCryoTempShield_ChC_K) OR

IF (rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) AND

ELSIF (rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChA_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) AND
      (rUHVChamberPressure_ChB_mbar > rUHVChamberPressure_ChC_mbar * rUHVPressureRatioLimit) THEN

(* =================================================================================================
   SECTION 3: SQUID MAGNETIC SHIELDING & ACTIVE 3-AXIS HELMHOLTZ FLUX COMPENSATION
   ================================================================================================= *)

(* SUB-SECTION 3.1: RESIDUAL SQUID FLUX EVALUATION & CLOSED-LOOP TRIM PID *)
(* Compute Internal Residual Flux Magnitude in [nT] from Cryogenic SQUID Readings *)
(* 1 fT = 1.0e-6 nT *)
rTotalResidualB_nT := SQRT(
    (rSQUIDResidualFluxX_fT * 1.0e-6) * (rSQUIDResidualFluxX_fT * 1.0e-6) +
    (rSQUIDResidualFluxY_fT * 1.0e-6) * (rSQUIDResidualFluxY_fT * 1.0e-6) +
    (rSQUIDResidualFluxZ_fT * 1.0e-6) * (rSQUIDResidualFluxZ_fT * 1.0e-6)
);

(* 3-Axis Helmholtz Active Flux Compensation Loop: Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) *)
(* Error Calculation relative to zero flux target *)
rFluxErrX_nT := 0.0 - (rAmbientMagneticFluxX_nT * 0.0010 + rSQUIDResidualFluxX_fT * 1.0e-6);
rFluxErrY_nT := 0.0 - (rAmbientMagneticFluxY_nT * 0.0010 + rSQUIDResidualFluxY_fT * 1.0e-6);
rFluxErrZ_nT := 0.0 - (rAmbientMagneticFluxZ_nT * 0.0010 + rSQUIDResidualFluxZ_fT * 1.0e-6);

(* Numerical Integration with Dynamic Anti-Windup Clamping *)
rFluxIntX_nT_s := rFluxIntX_nT_s + rFluxErrX_nT * rSampleTime_s;
rFluxIntY_nT_s := rFluxIntY_nT_s + rFluxErrY_nT * rSampleTime_s;
rFluxIntZ_nT_s := rFluxIntZ_nT_s + rFluxErrZ_nT * rSampleTime_s;

IF rFluxIntX_nT_s > 100.0 THEN rFluxIntX_nT_s := 100.0; ELSIF rFluxIntX_nT_s < -100.0 THEN rFluxIntX_nT_s := -100.0; END_IF;
IF rFluxIntY_nT_s > 100.0 THEN rFluxIntY_nT_s := 100.0; ELSIF rFluxIntY_nT_s < -100.0 THEN rFluxIntY_nT_s := -100.0; END_IF;
IF rFluxIntZ_nT_s > 100.0 THEN rFluxIntZ_nT_s := 100.0; ELSIF rFluxIntZ_nT_s < -100.0 THEN rFluxIntZ_nT_s := -100.0; END_IF;

(* Numerical Derivative Calculation *)
rFluxDerivX_nT_s := (rFluxErrX_nT - rPrevFluxErrX_nT) / rSampleTime_s;
rFluxDerivY_nT_s := (rFluxErrY_nT - rPrevFluxErrY_nT) / rSampleTime_s;
rFluxDerivZ_nT_s := (rFluxErrZ_nT - rPrevFluxErrZ_nT) / rSampleTime_s;
rPrevFluxErrX_nT := rFluxErrX_nT;
rPrevFluxErrY_nT := rFluxErrY_nT;
rPrevFluxErrZ_nT := rFluxErrZ_nT;

(* Active Helmholtz Current Output Calculation with Ambient Field Direct Feedforward *)
rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA := (rKp_Flux * rFluxErrX_nT + rKi_Flux * rFluxIntX_nT_s + rKd_Flux * rFluxDerivX_nT_s) + (rFeedforwardFluxGain * rAmbientMagneticFluxX_nT);
rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA := (rKp_Flux * rFluxErrY_nT + rKi_Flux * rFluxIntY_nT_s + rKd_Flux * rFluxDerivY_nT_s) + (rFeedforwardFluxGain * rAmbientMagneticFluxY_nT);
rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA := (rKp_Flux * rFluxErrZ_nT + rKi_Flux * rFluxIntZ_nT_s + rKd_Flux * rFluxDerivZ_nT_s) + (rFeedforwardFluxGain * rAmbientMagneticFluxZ_nT);

(* Actuator Saturation Limiting *)
IF rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA > rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA := rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; ELSIF rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA < -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentX_mA := -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA > rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA := rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; ELSIF rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA < -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentY_mA := -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; END_IF;
IF rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA > rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA := rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; ELSIF rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA < -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA THEN rActiveFluxCompCurrentZ_mA := -rMaxFluxCurrent_mA; END_IF;

(* SUB-SECTION 3.2: SECOND-ORDER ZEEMAN SYSTEMATIC FREQUENCY & PHASE COMPENSATION *)
